# Bundled causal-conv1d

Custom-environment source snapshot, version 1.0.0, required by the bundled BiMamba-v3. Install via `bash scripts/install_extensions.sh` from the repository root; see [the environment guide](../../README.md#1-install-the-environment). Existing `iccad26` users can use the installed compiled extension.

The setup script forces a local source build and requires a compatible full CUDA toolkit. Python/CUDA numerical code is unchanged. No compiled binaries are distributed.

Upstream: [Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d). Supplied [LICENSE](LICENSE), [AUTHORS](AUTHORS) and copyright headers are retained.
